rule: One authoritative owner per business record; contracts/events/projections only

owners.M01: Read-only executive summaries with source-completeness and drill-downs
owners.M03: Organisation, tenant, clinic, user and access scope
owners.M04: Workforce person, engagement, credential, restriction, readiness
owners.M06: Attendance, timesheets, approved publication to M07
owners.M07: Staff pay preparation only (not execution); PPA separately authorised
owners.M08: Doctor pay calculation/payslip/dispute records (no bank execution)
owners.M10: Tasks, checklist templates/occurrences, handovers, meeting actions
owners.M12: Compliance, accreditation, audit finding, CAPA verification
owners.M13: Controlled operational documents and policy versions
owners.M15: Stock, supplier, purchase, supplier invoice, equipment, rooms, printers, assets
owners.M16: Operational incident, complaint classification, risk, continuity
owners.M17: Governed outbound communications and delivery status
owners.M18: Digital monitoring, privileged access, secrets, security operations
owners.M19: Metric definitions, data-quality cases, change governance
owners.M22: Recruitment until controlled promotion into M04

mandatoryRelationships: M06 publishes approved timesheets to M07
M02 receives projections from every relevant module
M01 receives read-only summaries with source-completeness labels
M22 promotes candidates into M04 under controlled transition
M07/M08/M09/M24 remain separate ledgers connected by approved summaries
M10 wires tasks/checklists/handovers/meetings into M02 and M01
